scope: Actual FallenRider setup/advance/weapon release and Rider drawing, three zones and two directions at 30/60/120 steps with blood on/off. Geometric initial handover, bone lengths, neck range, finite held wrist, exact release boundary, ground/rest and postlanding joint motion. GPU 60-step sequence, camera-free staged grid. Direct visual-event fixtures, not genuine swept hits, normal Battle camera, OS input, full loose-weapon flight physics or player quality approval.
